scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof uses the flipping-edge even-cycle obstruction, explicit weighted-word transfer, and rational generating function. Independent finite computations provide corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Only even-degree graphs without even cycles satisfy the broad no-two-cycle theorem; exact count is only for labelled open triangular chains, not arbitrary cactus branches. No claims about time-to-convergence or attraction basins. Historical priority is subject to unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Odd-cactus majority relaxation and a cubic fixed-point law for triangular chains
